mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.book_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.parent_id, c.create_time, u.nick_name FROM book_comment c LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC

SELECT c.id, c.book_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.parent_id, c.create_time, b.book_name, u.nick_name FROM book_comment c LEFT JOIN book_info b ON b.id = c.book_id LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
